#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 2: exact wire format, boundaries, multi-hop, privacy matrix."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {
        "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
        "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
    },
    "accounts": {
        "session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]},
    },
    "gateways": {
        "edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}},
        "inside": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test", "sales.test"]}},
    },
}

def run(jobs, ctx=None):
    batch = dict(ctx or CTX)
    batch["jobs"] = jobs
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("exit %d %r" % (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[-3000:]))
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())["results"]

LOCAL = {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}
PEER = {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}

def build(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7", to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=t1",
          method="MESSAGE", uri="sip:inbox@relay.test", extra=None, body="hello",
          callid="cid-1", cseq="9 MESSAGE", clen=None):
    hs = [frm, to, "Call-ID: " + callid, "CSeq: " + cseq]
    if extra:
        hs = extra + hs
    if clen is None:
        clen = str(len(body))
    text = "%s %s SIP/2.0\r\n" % (method, uri) + "".join(h + "\r\n" for h in hs) \
           + "Content-Length: " + clen + "\r\n\r\n" + body
    return text

def j(gw="edge", ing=LOCAL, out=True, raw=None, source=None):
    d = {"gateway": gw, "ingress": ing, "trusted_out": out}
    if raw is not None:
        d["raw"] = raw
    else:
        d["source"] = source
    return d

def wire(method="MESSAGE", uri="sip:inbox@relay.test", frm="sip:ember@studio.test", ftag=";tag=q7",
         to="sip:inbox@relay.test", ttag=";tag=t1", callid="cid-1", cseq="9 MESSAGE",
         privacy="none", pai="sip:ember@studio.test", ctype=None, body="hello"):
    hs = ["%s %s SIP/2.0" % (method, uri),
          "From: <%s>%s" % (frm, ftag),
          "To: <%s>%s" % (to, ttag),
          "Call-ID: " + callid,
          "CSeq: " + cseq,
          "Privacy: " + privacy]
    if pai is not None:
        hs.append("P-Asserted-Identity: <%s>" % pai)
    if ctype is not None:
        hs.append("Content-Type: " + ctype)
    hs.append("Content-Length: %d" % len(body))
    return "\r\n".join(hs) + "\r\n\r\n" + body

fails = []
def check(name, got, exp):
    if got != exp:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL %s\n  got %s\n  exp %s" % (name, json.dumps(got), json.dumps(exp)))

def acc(ident="sip:ember@studio.test", basis="local", private=False, w=None):
    return {"status": "accept", "identity": ident, "basis": basis, "private": private, "wire": w}

def rej(reason):
    return {"status": "reject", "reason": reason}

ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"

# ---- exact wire formatting ----
check("wire-basic", run([j(raw=build())])[0],
      acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-invite", run([j(raw=build(method="INVITE", cseq="0009 INVITE"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(method="INVITE", cseq="9 INVITE")))
check("wire-notags", run([j(raw=build(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="To: <sip:desk@sales.test>"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(ftag="", to="sip:desk@sales.test", ttag="")))
check("wire-body-verbatim", run([j(raw=build(body="line1\r\nline2\tX \x00"[:0] + "line1\r\nline2\tend"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(body="line1\r\nline2\tend")))
check("wire-ctype-verbatim", run([j(raw=build(extra=["Content-Type: application/json  ;x=1"], body="{}"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(ctype="application/json  ;x=1", body="{}")))
check("wire-normalized-ruri", run([j(raw=build(uri="SIP:%69nbox@RELAY.TEST."))])[0],
      acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-normalized-to", run([j(raw=build(to="To: Display Name <SIP:inbox@RELAY.TEST.>;tag=t1"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-cseq-leading-zeros", run([j(raw=build(cseq="0000000009 MESSAGE"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire()))

# ---- privacy / PAI emission matrix ----
for private_src, hdr, expect_private in ((False, None, False), (False, "Privacy: none", False),
                                         (False, "Privacy: id", True), (False, "Privacy: ID", True),
                                         (True, None, True), (True, "Privacy: none", True)):
    frm = "From: <%s>;tag=q7" % (ANON if private_src else "sip:ember@studio.test")
    extra = [hdr] if hdr else None
    for out in (True, False):
        got = run([j(out=out, raw=build(frm=frm, extra=extra))])[0]
        pai = "sip:ember@studio.test" if (not expect_private or out) else None
        exp = acc(private=expect_private,
                  w=wire(frm=ANON if expect_private else "sip:ember@studio.test",
                         privacy="id" if expect_private else "none", pai=pai))
        check("privacy %s %s out=%s" % (private_src, hdr, out), got, exp)

# ---- multi-hop ----
r = run([j(raw=build()), j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=0),
         j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=1),
         j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, out=False, source=2)])
check("hop-chain", r[2], acc(basis="peer", w=wire()))
check("hop-chain-private", r[3], acc(basis="peer", private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai=None)))
r = run([j(raw=build()), j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, out=False, source=0),
         j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=1)])
check("hop-loss-pai", r[1], acc(basis="peer", w=wire(pai=None)))
check("hop-no-pai-upstream", r[2], rej("unauthenticated"))

# upstream propagation
r = run([j(raw=build(frm="From: <sip:zz@studio.test>;tag=q7")), j(source=0), j(source=1)])
check("upstream-1", r[0], rej("identity"))
check("upstream-2", r[1], rej("upstream"))
check("upstream-3", r[2], rej("upstream"))

r = run([j(raw=build()), j(source=0), j(source=1), j(source=2), j(source=3)])
check("self-chain", [x["status"] for x in r], ["accept"] * 5)

# source edge cases
check("source-oob", run([j(source=0)])[0], rej("upstream"))
check("source-negative", run([j(source=-1)])[0], rej("upstream"))
check("source-current", run([j(raw=build()), j(source=1)])[0], rej("upstream"))
check("source-nonint", run([{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True,
                            "source": "0"}])[0], rej("upstream"))
check("no-jobs", run([]), [])

# ---- body / length limits ----
body = "x" * 32700
base_len = len(build(body=""))
need = 32768 - base_len
body = "x" * need
text = build(body=body)
check("len-32768", len(text), 32768)
check("len-at-limit", run([j(raw=text)])[0]["status"], "accept")
check("len-over", run([j(raw=text + "y")])[0], rej("syntax"))

# growth: compact forms + added PAI make the wire longer than the raw
raw = build(frm="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
            callid="c", extra=["i: c"], body="x" * (32768 - len(build(frm="x", to="x", callid="c", extra=["i: c"], body=""))))
while len(raw) < 32768:
    raw = build(frm="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                callid="c", extra=["i: c"], body="x" * (len(raw) - len(build(frm="x", to="x", callid="c", extra=["i: c"], body="")) + 1))
    if len(raw) >= 32768:
        break
# simpler: build with a body sized exactly
skeleton = build(frm="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", callid="c", body="")
raw = build(frm="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", callid="c",
            body="x" * (32768 - len(skeleton)))
r = run([j(raw=raw), j(source=0)])
check("grown-wire-accept", r[0]["status"], "accept")
check("grown-wire-syntax", r[1], rej("syntax"))

# ---- structural limits ----
def with_headers(n, unfolded=False):
    hs = ["X-P%d: v" % i for i in range(n)]
    return build(extra=hs)

check("fields-128", run([j(raw=with_headers(124))])[0]["status"], "accept")
check("fields-129", run([j(raw=with_headers(125))])[0]["status"], "reject")
check("lines-limit-low", run([j(raw=with_headers(200))])[0]["reason"], "syntax")

# 512 physical header lines: 124 single + unfolded continuations
hs = []
for i in range(124):
    hs.append("X-P%d: v" % i)
hs.append("X-Last: v")
hs.append(" cont")
text = build(extra=hs)
check("lines-125", run([j(raw=text)])[0]["status"], "accept")

hs = ["X-P%d: v" % i for i in range(511)]
text = build(extra=hs)
check("lines-511", run([j(raw=text)])[0]["status"], "accept")
hs = ["X-P%d: v" % i for i in range(512)]
text = build(extra=hs)
check("lines-512", run([j(raw=text)])[0]["status"], "accept")
hs = ["X-P%d: v" % i for i in range(513)]
text = build(extra=hs)
check("lines-513", run([j(raw=text)])[0]["status"], "reject")

print("%d failures" % len(fails))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t2.py
